ITEM 1 | Bowl of pale green baby spinach leaves, flat and mostly whole, covering the base and rim of a white bowl roughly 15-18 cm across; leaves have slight sheen and some stems visible | 60
ITEM 2 | Diced cooked light-tan to off-white meat pieces, cubes about 1-1.5 cm with lightly browned edges and a firm, slightly fibrous surface, scattered across the upper and side areas | 85
ITEM 3 | Sliced avocado, pale green flesh in thick wedges about 0.5-1 cm thick and 4-6 cm long, with slightly glossy surface and some browning at edges, placed in a fan across the center | 55
ITEM 4 | Dark reddish-purple whole beans or halved pieces, glossy and wrinkled-skinned, about 1-1.5 cm, scattered among the greens and under the dressing | 25
ITEM 5 | Thick creamy white dressing, opaque and matte-to-slightly glossy, drizzled and pooled over the center and right side, flowing slowly and partly coating the chicken and avocado | 40
ITEM 6 | Small pale green cucumber or zucchini-like rounds, thin slices about 0.3 cm thick, scattered near the top edge and between avocado pieces, slightly translucent | 10
ITEM 7 | Small crumbled golden-brown toasted bits, irregular pieces about 0.5-1 cm, crisp-looking and dry, clustered near the lower left of the bowl | 8
